version_model.rule: Graph Runtime is generation v2; each newly named serialized schema starts at its own major v1.

durable_projection_record.payload_policy: bounded compact record; full graph state is rebuilt by the pinned reducer/applier and is never duplicated in each event
durable_projection_record.reader_window: v1 full projection records remain read-only for historical fixtures; v2 compact records are the only current writer

graph_events.boundary: Pin runtime generation, compiler, Workflow version, Graph IR version/checksum, and initial projection checksum before execution.
Commit one scheduler decision with input projection checksum and exact component versions.
Commit node instance, scope, activation ordinal, and budget reservation before dispatch.
Commit terminal node outcome and exact gate, activity, and effect references.
Commit condition policy and branch selection before target activation.
Commit fork identity and stable branch scopes.
Commit exact branch terminal evidence and failure policy result.
Commit loop entry, continuation, exit, or exhaustion with iteration and budget evidence.
Commit registration, resume, timeout, cancellation, timer wake, or approval evidence.
Commit Parallel-Any winner using authoritative successful transition stream sequence.
Commit cancellation request, termination confirmation, or indeterminate reconciliation state.
Commit stack push, mode entry, action scheduling, outcome, or manual intervention.
Atomically reserve, consume, release, or exhaust graph and run budget.
Commit lifecycle separately from terminal outcome and bind the resulting projection checksum.

side_effect_outcome_version_policy.upcast_reason: A historical serial outcome contains no evidence from which an attempt identity or fencing generation can be reconstructed.

compatibility_window.readers: Exact v1 and v2 readers remain enabled while either schema exists in durable side-effect records.
compatibility_window.v1_writer_scope: Retained only for serial side-effect execution.
compatibility_window.v2_writer_scope: Required for every fenced side-effect completion or reconciliation.
compatibility_window.v1_writer_retirement_gate: Retire only after every serial side-effect caller migrates under a later explicit OpenSpec change with replay fixtures.

side_effect_outcome_version_policy.unknown_version_outcome: typed side-effect outcome schema validation failure

legacy_readers.assignment_rule: Only a known v1 source adapter or manifest may assign this identity; missing schema_version alone is insufficient.
Only a known v1 state container may assign this identity.
Only a known v1 decision container may assign this identity.
Only a known v1 checkpoint store or manifest may assign this identity.
The enclosing validated v1 transition is required.

legacy_status_projection.override: INDETERMINATE only when durable evidence proves an uncertain external outcome

may_reconstruct: facts proven by v1 Workflow, state, transition, activity, side-effect, and checkpoint evidence
deterministic linear and conditional Graph IR from exact legacy Workflow declarations
must_not_invent: missing activity, gate, signal, timer, side-effect, or compensation outcome

phases.name: v2-only-write-and-execution-with-bounded-v1-readers
phases.entry: Graph contract, compiler, state, scheduler, Control Plane, event, checkpoint, replay, migration, and applicable release gates authorize cutover.
phases.rollback: A graph-capable reader is mandatory; an unsupported v2 run remains suspended and is never resumed by v1.

phases.name: v1-reader-upcaster-retirement
entry_gates: 12.6 migration, corruption, unknown-version, missing-evidence, and incompatible-graph fixtures pass
14.4 mixed v1/v2 Research inspection, recovery, artifact, and latest-result fixtures pass
14.5 all repository callers leave current_step_id and run-wide phase authority
all supported production v1 histories and checkpoints are deterministically migrated/read or explicitly quarantined with retained evidence
no production v1 writer or executor remains

fail_closed_rules: A v2 run is never downcast to current_step_id or resumed by a v1 executor.
An unversioned object outside an allowlisted legacy source is unknown_version, not v1.
A v1 reader never resolves the current compiler, reducer, or policy by default.
Missing graph checksum, projection checksum, last stream sequence, node identity, activity outcome, gate evidence, winner, Wait, or compensation evidence is never synthesized.
Replay never appends synthetic events to the source stream.
Unknown future schema majors are quarantined rather than treated as v1 or current.

change_control.before_first_graph_history_write: Update both registry files and the OpenSpec design/specs when semantics change.
change_control.after_graph_history_exists: Create a new schema or component version plus explicit reader/upcaster and replay fixtures; do not edit history meaning in place.

task_status.reason: The exact runtime/schema registry, explicit legacy reader policy, implementation constants, and evidence consistency tests are present.
